title: P15.9-B2: /app/company Company Cockpit on canonical businessCompany read
description: B2 of the approved P15.9-B0 master plan (PR #92): /app/company renders the real Company Cockpit reading only GET /api/vnext/businesses/:id/company via useSelectedBusiness() (B1 BizContext) — never enumerates /api/businesses, AbortController guards stale-response overwrite on business switch, prior business data dropped on switch/failure. Dashboard: company header (name/description/status), 4 stat cards (objectives_owned + targets_met_pending exact counts, status breakdown labeled 'of N returned', reported spend labeled aggregate over returned page), objectives_truncated warning banner, Needs Your Attention lane (fresh pending via company-side latest_review.owner_action_required only; global /api/approvals rows labeled 'global queue — not business-scoped'; HALT row states API_MISSING, no count), EntityCard grid (title/status/deadline/KpiBar with canonically_proven=false -> UNVERIFIED + unverifiable chip never MET-as-evidence, budget consumed/ceiling + proven|claimed badge, latest_review outcome + review_count), Recent reviews labeled 'not a full activity feed (API_MISSING)'. Honest states: no-business EmptyState, loading Skeletons, 401/403/DeniedState, FAIL_CLOSED_* integrity ErrorState with gloss, never error-to-empty. Zero backend/authority change, zero new deps. Harness-executable proof: cockpit + met-fold vitest suites unchanged-green. UI proof reported with PR: tsc PASS, vite build PASS, playwright e2e 29/29 PASS (app.spec 12 + company.spec 7 + smoke 5 + chat 5) against the real :8790 server.
